Key Takeaways:
- ChatGPT agent is designed for iterative, collaborative workflows, far more interactive and flexible than previous models.
- ChatGPT agent can perform complex online tasks on user's behalf and can switch between tasks seamlessly.
- ChatGPT agent is reportedly much more useful than initially perceived, and is able to browse the web, run code, and fill out forms.
